newsitem.title: USA: American Stores, Kodak unit in deal.
newsitem.headline: American Stores, Kodak unit in deal.

text.p: American Stores Co said Friday it signed an agreement to sell assets associated with its photofinishing operations to Qualex Inc, a subsidiary of Eastman Kodak Co, for an undisclosed price.
The company said the deal gives Qualex the exclusive right to provide photofinishing services to all food and drug stores operated by American Stores for ten years.
Under the terms of the agreement, the 600 American Stores associates employed in the photofinishing plants will be offered employment opportunities with Qualex at comparable wages and benefits.
American Stores Co associates will continue to operate the 175 in-store, one-hour photo processing labs included in the transaction.
The company said it expects the transaction to close in late October.
